fields.label: Enable Medusa integration
fields.description: Enables the connection to Medusa. Disabled: no sync, no webhook processing. Only enable once the connection has been tested.

fields.options:
Willkommen bei der Medusa-Integration

Diese Einstellungen verbinden Ihren ERPNext-Mandanten mit einem Medusa-v2-Backend. Bitte in dieser Reihenfolge vorgehen:

  1. Verbindung – Medusa-URL und API-Schlüssel eintragen, dann Verbindung testen.
  2. Storefronts – Storefronts aktualisieren klicken und gewünschte Kanäle aktivieren.
  3. Firma & Kunden – Standard-Firma, Standardkunde, Standardlager hinterlegen.
  4. Bestellungen – Nummernkreise und Belegautomatik einstellen.
  5. Produkt-Upload – erst Vorschau anzeigen, dann Jetzt synchronisieren.
  6. Integration aktivieren – ganz oben den Haken setzen.

Alle gefährlichen Schalter (z. B. Produkt-Upload, automatische Rechnungserstellung) sind standardmäßig aus. Bitte jeden Schalter erst nach einem Trockenlauf einschalten.

fields.label: Category sync (ERP → shop)
fields.description: Mirrors the ERPNext item-group tree 1:1 into Medusa product categories. One entry per root item group.

fields.options:
Catalog Mirror reflects the ERPNext Item Group tree 1:1 into Medusa's product-category tree. One Mirror per root Item Group. The Mirror creates / updates / re-parents Medusa categories so they match your ERP structure; the Item-to-Category linking happens automatically at product-export time based on each item's item_group.

Use this for your standard category structure. Use Smart Collections (below) for rule-based ad-hoc groupings (Sale, Bestseller, etc.) that don't follow the Item Group tree.

Browse all under Catalog Mirrors.

fields.label: Eigene Kollektionen (Sale, Bestseller, …)
fields.description: Rule-based collections that don't fall out of the item-group tree (e.g. Sale, Bestsellers, seasonal promotions).

fields.options:
Smart Collections are for rule-based ad-hoc groupings that don't follow the ERPNext Item Group tree — Sale, Bestseller, Black Friday, etc. Each collection's rules resolve to an item set; the Medusa category and the items it contains are managed by the sync.

For your standard category structure (one-to-one with Item Groups) use Catalog Mirror (above) instead.

Browse all under Smart Collections.

fields.description: Configurable Product Syncs (Ecommerce Product Sync). One entry per scope (sales channel × item group / filter). Preview, sandbox push, and Apply Live all run against the Sync — not against these settings.

fields.description: Incoming syncs (orders / customers / stock from Medusa to ERPNext). One cron interval per Pull Sync; manual run via the button below.

fields.label: Bestellungen (Eingang aus Medusa)
fields.description: How often orders are fetched from Medusa and which naming series are used.

fields.label: Bestell-Sync-Intervall (Minuten)
fields.description: How often orders are fetched from Medusa (in minutes).

fields.label: Letzter Bestell-Sync (informativ)

fields.label: Order confirmation naming series
fields.description: Naming series for order confirmations created from Medusa orders.

fields.label: Nummernkreis Lieferschein
fields.description: Naming series for delivery notes created from Medusa shipments.

fields.label: Beleg-Automatisierung
fields.description: Which follow-on documents are auto-created (delivery note, invoice). Before enabling, check that naming series and print formats are configured.

fields.label: Lieferscheine aus Medusa-Sendungen erstellen
fields.description: Wenn aktiviert: Sobald in Medusa eine Sendung (Fulfillment) erstellt wird, legt ERPNext automatisch einen Lieferschein an.

fields.label: Rechnung automatisch bei Versand erstellen
fields.description: Auto-creates an invoice as soon as the delivery note is submitted. Invoice date = shipment date. IMPORTANT: When disabled, you must create invoices manually.

fields.label: Create invoices for paid orders
fields.description: Creates an invoice as soon as payment is confirmed in Medusa.

fields.label: Rechnung automatisch per E-Mail versenden
fields.description: Verschickt die Rechnung als PDF an die Kunden-E-Mail-Adresse direkt nach der Erstellung.

fields.label: Zahlungs-Sync
fields.description: Wie und wann Medusa-Zahlungen in ERPNext als Zahlungseingang gebucht werden.

fields.label: Zahlungs-Status synchronisieren
fields.description: Wenn aktiviert: Sobald eine Medusa-Zahlung den Status 'captured' (eingenommen) erreicht, wird ein Zahlungseingang in ERPNext angelegt.

fields.label: Zahlungs-Sync-Intervall (Minuten)
fields.description: How often payment status is checked in Medusa.

fields.label: Letzter Zahlungs-Sync (informativ)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful payment pull. Informational only.

fields.label: Zahlungsart-Zuordnung
fields.description: Welche Medusa-Zahlart welcher ERPNext-Zahlungsart entspricht (z.B. Stripe → Stripe-Konto, PayPal → PayPal-Konto). Ohne Zuordnung wird die Standard-Zahlungsart unten verwendet.

fields.options:
Map Medusa payment provider ids (e.g. pp_stripe_stripe, pp_paypal_paypal, pp_system_default) to ERPNext Modes of Payment. Lookup order:

  1. Exact match in this table (case-insensitive).
  2. Partial match in this table (e.g. pp_stripe matches pp_stripe_card).
  3. Built-in defaults shipped with the plugin.
  4. The Default Mode of Payment below.

If none resolves to an existing Mode of Payment, the order is created without a Mode of Payment and the Payment Entry uses ERPNext's default.

fields.description: Used when none of the mappings above match. Without a selection, the ERPNext default payment method is used.
fields.label: Standard-Zahlungsart
Steuern
fields.description: Which tax template and shipping account is used for Medusa orders.

fields.label: Standard-Steuertemplate
fields.description: Default tax template for orders when no specific template can be determined.

fields.label: Standardkonto Versandkosten
fields.description: Konto, auf das Versandkosten aus Medusa-Bestellungen gebucht werden.

fields.label: Produkt-Upload (ERPNext → Medusa)
fields.description: Whether and how items are pushed from ERPNext to Medusa. CAUTION: These settings can overwrite existing Medusa data. Always run a dry-run before enabling.

fields.label: Upload ERPNext items to Medusa
fields.description: DANGEROUS: Enables outbound sync. Every new item and every item change is pushed to Medusa. WARNING: If you edit product copy directly in Medusa, it will be overwritten on the next ERPNext save. Run a full dry-run first to see the impact.

fields.label: Automatically push item changes to Medusa
fields.description: When enabled: every item change is pushed to Medusa immediately. When disabled: sync only happens manually per item via 'Sync now'.

fields.label: Publish new items as active in Medusa
fields.description: When enabled: newly uploaded items are visible in the shop immediately. When disabled: items are created as inactive and have to be released manually in Medusa.

fields.label: Category mapping
fields.options:
Item Group Mapping
Smart Collections Only
fields.description: Item Group Mapping (default): each item is auto-linked to the Medusa category corresponding to its ERPNext item group — plus any Smart Collections. Smart Collections Only: only Smart Collections drive categories — the item-group tree is not mirrored to Medusa. Pick this if you maintain your Medusa category tree exclusively via Smart Collections.

fields.label: Root item group for category sync
fields.description: Root item group from which the category tree is mirrored to Medusa.

fields.label: Item batch size
fields.description: Number of items per sync batch. Larger values = faster but more RAM.

fields.label: Bestand (Lager-Sync)

fields.label: Bestand-Sync-Intervall (Minuten)
fields.description: How often ERPNext stock is pushed to Medusa.

fields.label: Letzter Bestand-Sync (informativ)

ID of the Medusa Stock Location to which stock is reported. For multi-warehouse setups, fill out the mapping table below.

fields.label: Lager-Zuordnungen
fields.description: Map ERPNext warehouses to Medusa stock locations for multi-warehouse stock.

fields.label: Versand & Rabatte
